name: StoreTaskExecutionHub
tagline: Head-office campaigns executed in every store – checklists, photo proof, verification and compliance by region.
description: A complete store operations app for retailers in one Power Platform control: head office issues task campaigns (promotions, windows, price changes, recalls, safety walks, planograms, training) to stores by region; stores acknowledge, tick checklists, add compressed photo proof and submit; area managers verify or return with a reason under a four-eyes rule; dashboards show compliance by campaign, region and store, overdue and blocked tasks, on-time %, a campaign calendar and a region × campaign heat map.
features: Issue a campaign to all stores or selected regions/stores in one step (one task per store, NewRecordJson array)
Checklist per task – every step ticked before submission
Photo proof taken in the app, resized and compressed to a size limit
Verification by area managers / head office for Critical and High tasks, four-eyes rule
Return for rework with reason, rework counter and photo reset
Blockers with reasons; late reason required after the due date
Role-based actions (Store team, Area manager, Head office)
Compliance by campaign, region and store against a target; on-time %
Campaign calendar (start → due) and region × campaign heat map
Chase overdue stores – message grouped by area manager for Power Automate / Outlook
Kanban board with drag-and-drop and a keyboard Move menu
Bulk status changes, CSV task and compliance files, undo
Demo mode with about 200 fictional tasks
